documents.title: Academic Integrity: Important Guidelines for Students (2025)
documents.quality_note: Process document (meeting, appeal, hearing). AI appears in only two places: plagiarism includes presenting the work of 'an artificial intelligence' as one's own, and students must follow instructor guidelines on use of AI.
